steps.name: build_native
steps.cmd: { [ -f $HOME/.cargo/env ] && . $HOME/.cargo/env; true; } && (python rust/tools/cargo_ok.py 1.89 || curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable) && { [ -f $HOME/.cargo/env ] && . $HOME/.cargo/env; true; } && cargo --version && python rust/tools/build_fast.py && python -c 'from pgw.core import native; assert native.fast is not None, "pgw_fast not loaded"; print("pgw_fast", native.fast.version())' && python rust/tools/build_ntt.py && python -c 'from pgw.hemask import ntt; assert ntt.available(), "pgw_ntt not loaded"; print("pgw_ntt", ntt.info())'

steps.name: pack_q05
steps.cmd: python -m pgw.cli pack Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct /tmp/packs/q05 --name q05 -q && rm -rf $HOME/.cache/huggingface

steps.name: pack_q15
steps.cmd: python -m pgw.cli pack Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct /tmp/packs/q15 --name q15 -q && rm -rf $HOME/.cache/huggingface

steps.name: pack_q3
